scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Net SGST reimbursement to Micro, Small and Medium Manufacturing Enterprise (MSMEs)
other_conditions: The enterprise must have acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
New manufacturing enterprises or existing ones undertaking expansion or diversification are eligible
The enterprise must commence commercial production during the scheme's operative period (5 Oct 2022 to 4 Oct 2027)
The subsidy is based on the lower of the Gross Fixed Capital Investment (GFCI) or the cost appraised by a bank or financial institution
Enterprises must obtain separate GST registration for manufacturing eligible products
Separate books of accounts are required for each manufacturing unit, certified by a Chartered Accountant
Incentives apply only to goods manufactured on the enterprise's premises, not for resold goods
Compliance with all reporting and reimbursement requirements is mandatory
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement of net SGST for up to 10 years, with rates ranging from 80% to 100% of net SGST depending on the taluka category of the project.
documents_required: Chartered Accountant certified books of accounts
GST registration certificate for manufacturing eligible products
